data.title: Unit 3: The plant world
Classification of plants and plant cell
data.heading: Plant cell
data.text: The nucleus is the control centre of a plant cell.
The cytoplasm moves materials around the cell and also helps in dissolving the waste.
The cell wall acts as a protective wall for the cell, separating one cell from the other.
The cell membrane contains a chemical called cholesterol.
The vacuole stores water, food, and waste for the plant.
The chloroplasts absorb sunlight and help in the production of food for the plant.
